data.text:
M/S. Albanit And Co. Through Its Prop vs Union Territory Of J&K
And Others on 3 June, 2024 
Author: Sanjeev Kumar
Bench: Sanjeev Kumar
 Serial No. 142
 Regular List
 High Court Of Jammu & Kashmir And Ladakh
 At Srinagar
 Wp(C) No. 650/2023
 Cm No. 1537/2023
 Cm No. 4566/2023
M/S. Albanit and Co. through its Prop. ...Applicant(s)/Petitioner(s)
Through: Mr.Adil Asimi, Adv.
 Vs.
Union Territory of J&K and Others ...Respondent(s)
Through: Mr. Furqan Wani, Ga.
Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sanjeev Kumar, Judge.
 Order
03.06.2024
01.  In this petition, the petitioner has called in question e-Tender notice bearing No. SKIMS MC 08 of 2023 dated 3rd March, 2023 issued by the respondent No. 4. The petitioner seeks a direction to the respondents to necessarily incorporate the specific terms and conditions/guidelines contained under the Food, Safety and Standards Authority of India Act, 2006, ('FSSAI Act, 2006') and the rules and regulations framed thereunder. 
02. Learned counsel for the respondent-SKIMS states at bar that in view of the expiry of validity of e-Tenders, the respondents have decided to issue fresh e-Tender notice for the work in question. It is submitted that, while issuing the fresh e-Tender notice, care shall be taken to incorporate necessary terms and conditions under the FSSAI Act, 2006.
03. In view of the aforesaid submissions made by learned counsel for the respondent-SKIMS that the grievance of the petitioner in this petition stands redressed, this petition is virtually rendered infructuous and is disposed of as such. The respondents shall issue fresh e-Tender for the work in question. The respondents, while doing so, shall keep in view the requisite terms and M/S. Albanit And Co. 1 conditions/guidelines on the subject contained under the FSSAI Act 2006 and the rules and regulations framed thereunder and made them part of tender. 
04. Disposed of along with connected CM(s).
(SANJEEV KUMAR) JUDGE SRINAGAR:
